name: 范書愷
objective:
注重環境永續、社會責任與公司治理的 ESG 原則，已成全球風潮，更是決定企業未來是否能順利接到訂單之關鍵，也是維繫企業在產業鏈永續發展之命脈。換言之，落實 ESG 原則，將帶動企業高成長、創造更多的社會福祉。 本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動 ESG 之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析 ESG 如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。本課程也會讓學生藉由規劃與實施一項公益活動，以實踐企業倫理與社會責任，並藉以思考在推展企業倫理、企業社會責任與公司治理等理念時，如何能落實於企業的體制之中，以建立一個永續發展的企業價值體系。
ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being. This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability. This course is also designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.
課程進度(1-16週): In my segment, I will focus on the convergence of digital transformation and the green transition. Particular emphasis will be placed on how enterprises can harness state-of-the-art AI capabilities to build AI-ready industrial data foundations, reengineer operational processes, and establish robust governance, security, and human-in-the-loop guardrails. These capabilities are essential for enabling the next generation of autonomous industrial operations and production systems, powered by agentic AI workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and closed-loop decision-making.

name: 耿慶瑞
objective:
在管理決策中，要如何做行銷管理才能使得公司的產品賣得出去並增加公司收入。要如何做資金管理才能使得公司可以正常營運並將資金做適當的管理決策配置。透過國內外相關公司案例的討論，讓學生可以瞭解消費者行為、市場區隔、產品策略、通路、數位 (含 AI) 行銷等議題，以及對財管的投資、融資、營運資金、公司理財等議題有進一步的理解，讓高階經理人可以有更全面的策略營運方針。
In management decisions, how should marketing management be conducted to ensure that a company's products sell and increase company revenue? How should financial management be handled to ensure the company operates smoothly and makes appropriate management decisions regarding the allocation of funds? Through discussions of relevant domestic and international company cases, students can gain an understanding of topics such as consumer behavior, market segmentation, product strategy, distribution channels, and digital (including AI) marketing, as well as develop a deeper understanding of financial management topics like investment, financing, working capital, and corporate finance. This will enable senior managers to develop more comprehensive strategic operational guidelines.
課程進度(1-16週):
上海 EMBA 班行銷與財務管理上課大綱
